text: しばらくは　あきんわい

structure.en: I won't get bored, I tell you

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is a short, old-man way of saying ない, 'not'. あきん = 'won't get bored'.

patterns.name: 〜わい
patterns.explanation: わい at the end is an old-man way of adding feeling, like 'I tell you'. あきんわい = 'I won't get bored, I tell you'.
